endorsements.name: Kelby Ludwig
endorsements.label: CVE-2017-11427
endorsements.description: OneLogin PythonSAML 2.3.0 and earlier may incorrectly utilize the results of XML DOM traversal and canonicalization APIs in such a way that an attacker may be able to manipulate the SAML data without invalidating the cryptographic signature, allowing the attack to potentially bypass authentication to SAML service providers.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.0, 7.7)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
